args: $bp = Get-Content 'blueprint.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $out = '${workspaceFolderBasename}-' + $bp.version + '.kbp'; Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $out, 'build.zip'; Compress-Archive -Path 'blueprint.json', 'versions.ts', 'icon.png' -DestinationPath 'build.zip'; Rename-Item -Path 'build.zip' -NewName $out; Write-Host ('Built: ' + $out)

linux.command: VER=$(grep -oE '"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]+"' blueprint.json | head -n 1 | cut -d'"' -f4) && OUT="${workspaceFolderBasename}-${VER}.kbp" && rm -f "$OUT" && (zip -q "$OUT" blueprint.json versions.ts icon.png 2>/dev/null || python3 -m zipfile -c "$OUT" blueprint.json versions.ts icon.png) && echo "Built: $OUT"

osx.command: VER=$(grep -oE '"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]+"' blueprint.json | head -n 1 | cut -d'"' -f4) && OUT="${workspaceFolderBasename}-${VER}.kbp" && rm -f "$OUT" && (zip -q "$OUT" blueprint.json versions.ts icon.png 2>/dev/null || python3 -m zipfile -c "$OUT" blueprint.json versions.ts icon.png) && echo "Built: $OUT"
